whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Romeo Lane Patna,

I noticed your upscale lounge on Boring Road has strong 4.2★ reviews from 290+ patrons, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and table reservation portal.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table reservation, digital menu showcase, aur instant WhatsApp inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/romeolane

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Romeo Lane Patna, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct table reservation, digital food & cocktail menu preview, and mobile-first speed for Boring Road patrons. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual dishes, photos, aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
